questions.question: Explain why adjustments exist at year end, and work both Grade 10 adjustments at Zanele's Traders with their double entries and authorising principles.
questions.expected_answer: The ledger records the year as documented, but some year-end truths have no document — so adjustments align recorded figures with fact. Stationery of R1 500 includes R300 unused: credit Stationery R300, debit Consumable Stores on Hand R300, so the expense reports the R1 200 consumed (matching). Trading Stock claims R3 100 but the count finds R2 880: credit Trading Stock R220, debit Trading Stock Deficit R220, recognising the loss immediately (prudence). Both are complete double entries, so the post-adjustment trial balance still levels.

questions.question: Describe how the two final accounts compute the year's profit, giving the figures at each stage.
questions.expected_answer: The Trading account isolates the trading result: Sales of R150 000 closes to its credit, Cost of Sales R100 000 to its debit, leaving a gross profit of R50 000 — confirming the 50% mark-up on cost. That transfers to Profit and Loss, joined by Rent Income of R9 000 for R59 000 of earnings; then the expenses close to the debit side — Salaries 18 000, Telephone 1 550, adjusted Stationery 1 200, Bank Charges 430, Trading Stock Deficit 220 — totalling R21 400. The balance, R37 600, is the net profit, transferred to Capital: debit Profit and Loss, credit Capital.

questions.question: State the six steps of the year-end run in order and explain why the strict order is itself a control.
questions.expected_answer: Pre-adjustment trial balance; adjustments journalised with narrations; post-adjustment trial balance; final accounts (Trading, then Profit and Loss); profit transferred to Capital; then the financial statements. Each step certifies the next: proving balance first stops old errors hiding among the adjustments, and adjusting before the final accounts stops the profit being wrong by every unadjusted rand. Skipping or reordering steps removes the certification each stage passes to the one after it.
